Russian strikes destroy millions of textbooks in Ukraine

Russian strikes have destroyed approximately 12 million textbooks in Ukraine ahead of the new school year. The attacks targeted educational facilities and infrastructure. The destruction of these books raises concerns about the continuity of education for Ukrainian students.
